newsitem.title: USA: Seagram's Universal names Solomon TV head.
newsitem.headline: Seagram's Universal names Solomon TV head.

text.p: Seagram Co LTd affiliate Universal Television on Wednesday said it has named Ken Solomon as its new president, replacing Tom Thayer who stepped down from the post last week to become a producer for the company.
Solomon has served as co-head of television at movie studio DreamWorks SKG since August 1995. At DreamWorks he shared responsibility for TV program development, production, sales and marketing.
"I am confident he will energize our network division and lead us to new levels," Greg Meidel, chairman of Universal Television, said in a statement.

Prior to joining DreamWorks, Solomon served as executive vice president of network distribution at FOX Broadcasting, a division of News Corp Ltd. At FOX, he was responsible for transitioning stations affiliated with other networks to the FOX brand. He also helped launch the FX cable network.
Solomon has also worked for the Walt Disney Co's Buena Vista domestic television division and Viacom Inc's Paramount domestic television wing.
